data.name: Roman Urdu Sentiment Analysis Dataset (RUSAD)
data.abstract: The dataset was gathered to carry out research on the task of sentiment analysis for Roman Urdu.

intro_paper.title: Sentiment Analysis System for Roman Urdu
intro_paper.authors: Khawar Mehmood, D. Essam, Kamran Shafi
intro_paper.venue: Advances in Intelligent Systems and Computing

additional_info.summary: The dataset has two columns. The first column has the binary categorical information (positive, negative) and the second column has the actual review.
